sophie_csm: Quick weekly check-in for acme onboarding — noticing a rise in errors this week, can folks call out top types? 5xx / timeouts / rate-limits? Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/s/acme/onboard-ops

maria_cs: 5xx % up 2.8pp week-over-week. Timeouts up during batch imports (16:00-18:00 UTC) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aj_engineer: I see a deploy on Thu 03:22 that changed batching config for embeddings. Could be related. Rollout id: r-3487

kevin_ops: alert_bot flagged request latency spike at 2026-03-18T16:05Z. Sample logs:
```json
{"path":"/v1/embeddings","status":504,"lat_ms":120010}
{"path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"lat_ms":7400}
```

maria_cs: Top failing endpoints by count this week:
- /v1/embeddings — 452 failures (45%)
- /v1/generate — 312 failures (31%)
- /health/check — 85 failures (8%) — mostly timeouts
- /v1/batch/submit — 60 rate-limited (12% of requests)

aj_engineer: Confirmed the embedding batcher had aggressive windowing; can roll back to previous window. Also seeing KV cache misses causing extra compute during long seqs.

kevin_ops: Temp mitigation: enable fallback to smaller model for heavy batch windows + increase backend retries from 2 -> 4 for /v1/embeddings. Will push canary today morning.

alert_bot: ALERT — spike in 5xx across acme-prod between 2026-03-18T15:50Z and 2026-03-18T18:20Z. Peak 5xx rate: 7.2% of traffic. Link: https://redwood.app/alerts/ACME-5XX-231

sophie_csm: Thanks — action items:
- aj: rollback/adjust batch window on embeddings and report perf delta (ETA: 6h)
- kevin: canary retries + fallback config (ETA: 4h)
- maria: update account note and check renewal risk if errors persist (ETA: EOD)
I'll follow up in next checkin. cc @aj_engineer @kevin_ops :thumbsup:

sophie_csm: quick ask — can we capture one example request id for a 504 from embeddings to attach to support ticket? 
maria_cs: grabbing one, will paste shortly.

maria_cs: example_request_id: req_8b7f4a — full logs uploaded to /mnt/support/acme/req_8b7f4a.log

aj_engineer: thanks, I'll correlate with deploy. If rollback helps, we can schedule a controlled redeploy tomorrow.

kevin_ops: monitoring dashboard updated with temporary panel for 'acme onboard 5xx by endpoint' :bar_chart: https://redwood.app/dash/acme-5xx

sophie_csm: perfect. No blocker for renewal call yet but keep me posted — I'll flag if next check shows >5% sustained 5xx. End.
